item.description: Discover the secret gems of Hong Kong’s drinking scene with the best speakeasy bars, including 001, Foxglove, Ping Pong 129, and Please Don’t Tell. The post The best speakeasies and secret bars to find in Hong Kong for secluded drinks appeared first on Foodie.

item.title: The best restaurants in Sheung Wan for quick lunches and long dinners
